rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account before accessing order details. It correctly identified the Bluetooth speaker’s price and battery life from the tools. When asked to cancel the speaker, the agent sought confirmation, then attempted the change; upon tool restriction (exchange required), it informed the user and requested consent to swap instead. It provided accurate, available under-$300 options, received explicit confirmation for the chosen variant, executed the exchange correctly, and reported the correct new total ($1,288.65) and refund ($30.78). No unsupported claims or unauthorized actions occurred, and writes were done only after explicit user approval.
